Discussion sentences about published studies and cohorts are background, not patient facts.

Figure 2 plots serial laboratory values and drug bars; only printed text is recorded in the visual submission, with no values read from the plot.
The authors state IL-18 levels and anti-MDA5 antibody titers were not systematically collected or serially monitored.

key_findings: Single index patient (3-year-old girl, anti-MDA5-positive JDM with RP-ILD); Table 1 rows are eight published adult cases and stay aggregate.

ESR, ferritin and D dimer are each named in the "elevated inflammatory markers:" list and ALT, AST, LDH and CK in the "increased serum myogenic enzymes:" list, so all seven high flags are literal; later rises ("elevated laboratory indicators ... from ... to") stay unflagged.
Ferritin 316 ng/ml is printed as the end of the initial response and the start of the deterioration; kept as two observations with an ambiguity (not stated to be the same measurement).
SpO2 92%-93% kept as text; high-flow nasal oxygen "requiring" kept action unknown; muscle biopsy not_performed ("despite the absence of a muscle biopsy").
Figure 2 prints month/day axis dates of the patient course; direct_identifiers flag agreed.
